title: MITRE-funded papers detecting gravitons near atmosphere

tellings.quote: However, there are papers that have since that were funded by the MITRE Corporation going back 20, 25 years that show that gravitons were both very high frequency and extremely low frequency gravitons were detectable near the Earth's atmosphere.

plain: Research papers paid for by the MITRE Corporation, a research organisation, some 20 to 25 years ago are said to show that gravitons, the proposed particles of gravity, can be detected near Earth's atmosphere, at both very high and extremely low frequencies. A researcher named Dave Rossi tells Michels this from his own reading, without naming the papers or their authors. If true, it would mean gravity could be measured and perhaps worked with in ways mainstream physics does not yet allow.
